title: AKTU Free AI & ML Course with IIT Madras: 30 Hours, 1 Academic Credit & Certificate Details
excerpt: AKTU partners with IIT Madras for a 30-hour free AI & Machine Learning course awarding 1 academic credit. Read syllabus, registration process, eligibility, and certification guidelines.
content:
## Executive Summary & Official Circular Highlights

Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has officially communicated a major skill-enhancement and academic upskilling opportunity for all undergraduate and postgraduate engineering, pharmacy, and management scholars enrolled across its 750+ affiliated institutes in Uttar Pradesh. Under this comprehensive initiative, AKTU students can enroll in an exclusive **30-hour certified Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI & ML) training program** designed and curated by domain specialists from the prestigious **Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras)**.

Crucially, this specialized course is offered **100% free of tuition costs** to active AKTU students and has been formally integrated into the university academic credit architecture, granting **1 full academic credit** upon successful completion and assessment submission.

Here are the core takeaways from the university announcement:
* **Program Name:** 30-Hour Foundation & Applied Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning Certification
* **Curating Academy:** Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras) in association with national e-learning initiatives
* **Academic Credit Allocation:** 1 Credit transferable towards open elective / MOOC credits under AKTU NEP guidelines
* **Total Training Duration:** 30 Hours of self-paced digital video lectures, interactive modules, and practical coding exercises
* **Tuition & Examination Fee:** 100% Free of cost for all verified AKTU university roll number holders
* **Eligible Branches:** B.Tech (All Branches including CSE, AI, IT, ECE, EE, ME, Civil), B.Pharma, MCA, MBA, and M.Tech candidates
* **Official Verification Desk:** Students can verify their enrolled semester status and SGPA history via the [AKTU OneView Portal](https://akturesult.bond/oneview) or check their academic standing directly on [AKTU Result Online](https://akturesult.bond).

---

## Background of the AKTU & IIT Madras Upskilling Partnership

With rapid advancements across generative artificial intelligence, neural networks, computer vision, and large language models (LLMs), technical employers are increasingly seeking graduates equipped with foundational AI competence regardless of their primary engineering stream. Acknowledging this shifting industry landscape, the AKTU Academic Council and Board of Studies have collaborated with premier premier national institutes like IIT Madras to deliver high-quality, industry-benchmarked AI curricula directly to students studying in tier-2 and tier-3 colleges across Uttar Pradesh.

Traditionally, high-end certified courses in Machine Learning and Prompt Engineering from premier Indian Institutes of Technology carry substantial certification fees ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹25,000. Through this state-supported academic tie-up, AKTU ensures that students from rural, suburban, and urban institutions have equal access to state-of-the-art computational learning without financial barriers.

Educational observers and university watchers note that this course represents an important step in bridging the gap between theoretical classroom syllabi and live industry hiring benchmarks. In particular, students pursuing branches such as Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, and Chemical engineering can leverage this certified credential to demonstrate software and automated computing acumen during campus placement drives.

---

## Course Curriculum & Technical Modules Breakdown

Designed by faculty from the Department of Computer Science & Engineering and the Robert Bosch Centre for Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (RBCDSAI) at IIT Madras, the 30-hour syllabus is meticulously partitioned into four progressive modules covering fundamentals to advanced real-world implementations.

### Module 1: Computational Foundations & Python for Data Science (Hours 1–8)
* Introduction to algorithmic thinking and computational pipelines
* Python environment setup: Jupyter Notebooks, Google Colab, and essential libraries (`NumPy`, `Pandas`, `Matplotlib`)
* Data wrangling, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and automated data cleaning techniques
* Statistical foundations: Probability distributions, mean squared errors, and linear algebra basics for machine learning

### Module 2: Core Machine Learning Algorithms & Predictive Modeling (Hours 9–16)
* Supervised Learning: Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, and Random Forests
* Model evaluation metrics: Precision, Recall, F1-Score, ROC-AUC curves, and confusion matrix interpretation
* Unsupervised Learning: K-Means clustering, hierarchical grouping, and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for dimensionality reduction
* Practical hands-on exercise: Building a predictive price and customer churn model from scratch in Python

### Module 3: Deep Learning, Neural Networks & Computer Vision Basics (Hours 17–24)
* Foundations of Artificial Neural Networks (ANN): Perceptrons, activation functions (ReLU, Sigmoid, Softmax), and backpropagation algorithms
* Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for image recognition and edge detection
* Introduction to Natural Language Processing (NLP): Tokenization, TF-IDF, vector embeddings, and sentiment classification
* Code-along project: Building a handwritten digit recognizer using open-source datasets

### Module 4: Generative AI, LLMs & Industry Deployment (Hours 25–30)
* The architecture of Large Language Models: Transformers, attention mechanisms, and foundational AI models
* Practical Prompt Engineering: Few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought prompting, and automated workflow scripting
* Ethics, bias mitigation, and responsible AI deployment in modern enterprise infrastructure
* Final capstone assessment: Creating an AI-assisted domain chatbot and deployment workflow

---

## Academic Credit Transfer & University Ordinance Compliance

One of the most valuable aspects of this program for enrolled AKTU students is its formal academic credit recognition under the National Education Policy (NEP 2020) framework adopted by the university.

```
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                  AKTU 1-CREDIT TRANSFER ARCHITECTURE (NEP 2020)                  |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                                  |
|   [30-Hour Coursework]  --->  [Module Quizzes + Capstone]  --->  [Passing >50%]  |
|                                                                        |         |
|                                                                        v         |
|   [Academic Credit Bank] <---  [ERP Credit Submission]   <---  [Certificate]    |
|   (Transferred to SGPA)        (Submitted via College)          (IIT Madras)     |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

Key academic guidelines governing credit transfer include:
1. **Elective Credit Substitution:** Students in semesters 4th through 8th can submit the completion certificate to their departmental academic coordinator to claim 1 credit against open elective or value-added course requirements.
2. **Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) Sync:** The earned credit is logged directly into the student's ABC ID / Digilocker account linked to their AKTU University Roll Number.
3. **OneView Marksheet Reflection:** Upon college verification on the university ERP portal, the 1 credit will be reflected in the internal sessional/elective grade column of your official [AKTU OneView Marksheet](https://akturesult.bond/oneview).
4. **No Clash with Regular Exam Timetables:** Since the coursework is 100% self-paced and recorded online, candidates do not need to alter their semester lecture attendance or college laboratory schedules.

---

## Step-by-Step Registration & Enrollment Guide

Follow these sequential steps to ensure proper enrollment, verified student status, and valid certificate issuance upon program completion:

1. **Check Your Academic Standing:** Ensure your enrollment credentials are fully active by checking your semester details on [AKTU Result Portal](https://akturesult.bond). Keep your 13-digit University Roll Number handy.
2. **Access the University Circular Portal:** Visit the AKTU circulars archive or check your college ERP bulletin for the official invitation link.
3. **Authenticate via Student Credentials:** During the registration form fill-up, enter your official name exactly as printed on your university admit card and high school certificate to prevent discrepancies on your final IIT Madras certificate.
4. **Select Your Course Track:** Opt for the 30-Hour AI & ML Foundation Track and ensure that your college code (which you can verify on the [AKTU Colleges Directory](https://akturesult.bond/colleges)) is accurately matched.
5. **Complete Video Modules & Knowledge Checks:** Progress through the lectures systematically. Each section features short 5-question comprehension quizzes that must be completed to unlock subsequent chapters.
6. **Submit Final Capstone Project:** At the conclusion of Module 4, submit your practical assignment or multiple-choice final assessment within the declared submission window.

---

## Assessment, Quizzes & IIT Madras Certification Process

To maintain the high academic standard expected of an IIT-backed credential, candidates must satisfy specific performance benchmarks:

| Assessment Component | Weightage | Minimum Passing Criteria | Retake Policy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Module Self-Check Quizzes** | 30% of Total Score | 50% average across all 4 modules | Up to 3 attempts allowed per quiz |
| **Practical Coding Lab / Tasks** | 30% of Total Score | Successful execution & code upload | 1 resubmission allowed |
| **Final Proctored Online Exam** | 40% of Total Score | Minimum 50% marks in final test | Single scheduled sitting |
| **Overall Aggregate Requirement** | 100% | **Overall Score >= 50%** | Certificate issued with Distinction if >= 75% |

Upon crossing the 50% aggregate mark, an automated digitally signed certificate bearing the logos of AKTU Lucknow and IIT Madras will be generated. The certificate includes a cryptographically verifiable QR code allowing prospective recruiters, LinkedIn profile visitors, and college administrative boards to authenticate the student's credentials instantly.

---

## Career Impact, Industry Placement & Resume Value

In recent campus placement rounds across Uttar Pradesh colleges, recruiters from tier-1 IT services firms (TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, HCL) as well as product development startups have increasingly integrated technical evaluations around machine learning pipelines and data querying into their preliminary technical rounds.

Having an IIT Madras accredited certificate on your CV provides distinct competitive advantages:
* **Resume Differentiation:** Distinguishes your profile from thousands of conventional engineering graduates by showing proactive, self-directed professional education.
* **Placement Interview Advantage:** Provides concrete project discussion points for technical interviews, especially regarding practical Python data wrangling and neural network deployment.
* **Higher Education Eligibility:** Strengthens applications for M.Tech, MS, and PhD admissions both in Indian institutes (GATE interviews) and foreign universities where documented research and technical coursework are heavily weighed.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### Is the IIT Madras AI & ML course completely free for all AKTU students?
Yes, the 30-hour course, lecture materials, and standard digital certification are 100% free for all currently enrolled students across AKTU affiliated colleges. Students only need to authenticate with their valid University Roll Number.

### Can students from non-CS branches like Mechanical, Civil, or Pharmacy enroll?
Absolutely. The program is explicitly designed as an interdisciplinary skill initiative open to students from all branches, including B.Tech Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, B.Pharma, MCA, and MBA candidates.

### How will the 1 academic credit be added to my AKTU OneView marksheet?
Upon successfully completing the course with a passing score of 50% or above, download your verified certificate and submit a copy to your departmental college exam cell. Your college will upload the credit verification to the AKTU ERP portal, after which it will reflect in your official OneView grade ledger.

### What if I cannot find my registered Date of Birth to check my current SGPA?
You can use the free [AKTU Result Without DOB](https://akturesult.bond) portal to check your complete semester scorecard, SGPA, CGPA, and backlog status using only your University Roll Number.

### Will I get a physical certificate or a digital e-certificate?
Students receive a high-resolution digital e-certificate equipped with a secure verification QR code and unique credential ID issued jointly by IIT Madras faculty coordinators and AKTU Lucknow.

### Can I access the lectures on mobile devices or is a laptop mandatory?
The video lectures and quizzes can be accessed on any modern smartphone, tablet, or laptop. However, for coding assignments in Google Colab and Python labs, a laptop or desktop computer is recommended for optimal productivity.
